text:
mike: Quick follow-up from last night's vendor auth outage postmortem. Can we lock owners/timelines for the action items? I'll run a short triage sync at 11:30 PT. tl;dr: cloud auth retries, model-registry token refresh, vendor SSO failover. @sophia @lia please confirm owners.

sophia: I can own cloud auth retries + circuit breaker work. Plan: add client-side exponential backoff + structured metrics, plus a simple circuit-breaker around vendor calls. ETA: EOD Tue (48h). Will open a PR against infra-lib. :thumbsup:

lia: I'll take the model-registry token refresh and rotation tests. Need infra help to wire KMS in staging and validate refresh flow. ETA: Thu EOD. I'll add a test harness and a runbook section.

jordan: Security will own vendor client secret rotation + runbook updates. I'll validate current policy and set a 48h rotation window for high-risk tokens. ETA: Fri.

pm-ryan: From product side I'll prepare the customer-communication templates and the SLA impact blurb. Assign to me, ETA: next Wed. Will sync with legal on wording.

ash: (eng-ml) I'll prototype a lightweight local-model fallback for auth degradation (small quantized variant packaged with service). Idea: failover when auth is clearly degraded to keep low-latency read-only responses. ETA: 1 week for prototype.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT:INC-2026-45 created for follow-up items. Reminder set for 72h.

mike: Thanks. I'll capture these owners in the postmortem doc and update the GH issue. Note: we've seen 3 vendor auth blips in the last 6 months — recurring pattern. Propose: vendor SLA review + explore alternate auth provider as a long-term mitigation. @pm-ryan can you add that to the roadmap discussion?

lia: I'll run a chaos test in staging around token expiry tomorrow 9am PT (will simulate KMS rotation / token revocation). Posting test plan in the doc after this.

sophia: Also enabling request-level tracing for vendor auth failures (X-Auth-Trace header) so we can correlate client retries -> vendor errors. Small change, pushing a PR today.

ash: Quick sketch for fallback logic below — can reuse across services:

```
if (auth_status == 401 && retries > 2) {
  route_to_local_model();
  emit_metric('fallback_triggered');
}
```

mike: Nice. I'll compile an action tracker with owners/ETA/linked tickets. Anyone wanting to adjust ETA ping here. I'll post the GH issue number once created.

jordan: One more security ask: rotate vendor client secret now and ensure the vault rotation is automated. We want rotation window <= 48h for that secret and an automated smoke test to confirm new token validity.

sophia: noted.

pm-ryan: Meeting invite sent for 11:30 PT today — agenda: owners, timelines, customer comms, and vendor SLA decision path. Please accept.

mike: Acknowledged. I'll bring the compiled action list to the sync.

(End of thread)
